title: E01 Adjudicated Capability Matrix
description: Validates the derived E01 adjudicated capability matrix (protocol/unresolved.md, PROTO-U05, corrected by PROTO-U06), written to derived-data/e01-adjudicated-matrix/E01-adjudicated-matrix.json. A purely representational, deterministic materialization of the 6x9 = 54 already-decided E01 cells: the immutable auditor confirmed_score/provisional_score (audits/<SUT>/audit.md at the pinned auditor result commit) for every CONFIRMED cell, and the human_effective_confirmed_score of derived-data/adjudication-rulings/*.json for the two DISPUTED-then-ruled cells. Introduces no new rubric level, evidence status, or adjudication outcome beyond those already defined by protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md and schemas/adjudication.schema.json (which this schema does not modify); resolution_source and resolution_source_id are provenance-only fields distinguishing which of those two already-authorized paths produced effective_confirmed_score. Contains no composite, weighted, or aggregated score, index, rank, or winner (protocol/statistical-analysis-plan-v1.md; derived-data/README.md rule 5; analysis/README.md rule 6). v2 supersedes v1 (schemas/adjudicated-matrix.schema.json, urn:eus-2026-001:schemas:adjudicated-matrix:v1) per PROTO-U06 (protocol/unresolved.md): v1 conflated the literal audits/<SUT>/audit.md confirmed_score column (blank on some rows) with the fallback-derived value used for effective_confirmed_score, storing the fallback in confirmed_score_as_stored and losing the fact that the source row was blank. v2 corrects only this representation; it changes no cell's effective_confirmed_score, no rubric level, no evidence status, and no adjudication outcome. v1 instance data (git history, commit 77216f610a341fe87fb3c90c4035de73d66ca29d) remains valid against schemas/adjudicated-matrix.schema.json (schemas/README.md, 'Changing a schema': 'Data produced under an earlier schema version stays valid against that version').

generated_at.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) this matrix was generated, per analysis/e01-adjudicated-matrix/generate-matrix.js.

sources.description: Provenance of every input this matrix was deterministically derived from. No field here is scientific content.

auditor_result_commits.description: Ecosystem id to immutable auditor result commit SHA (audits/<SUT>/audit.md at that commit).

adjudication_first_run.description: Ecosystem id to the immutable first-run ADJUDICATOR-EU-01 output file this matrix read, and its SHA-256.

human_rulings.description: ruling_id to the human-ruling record this matrix read, and its SHA-256.

cells.description: Exactly 54 entries: 6 ecosystems x 9 frozen E01 modalities (protocol/study-design-v1.md), no duplicate, no missing.

effective_confirmed_score.description: The score this matrix records for the cell. When original_adjudicator_outcome is CONFIRMED: confirmed_score_as_stored when it is non-null, otherwise provisional_score (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md's own stated fallback for a blank confirmed_score column; analysis/README.md rule 7 -- the same, already-frozen fallback rule, not a new one introduced by PROTO-U06). When original_adjudicator_outcome is DISPUTED-then-ruled: the human ruling's effective score. Never summed, averaged, weighted, or aggregated across cells (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md).

confirmed_score_as_stored.description: The literal value recorded in the immutable audits/<SUT>/audit.md confirmed_score column (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, Tie-break rule) at the pinned auditor result commit, unmodified by any human ruling. null means that column was left blank in that row -- protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md's own ordinary case where confirmed_score equals provisional_score and the auditor did not repeat it (observed, by direct inspection: all 9 SUT-02 cells, all 9 SUT-06 cells, and the SUT-03 Android Native / iOS Native cells; protocol/unresolved.md, PROTO-U06). A non-null value is the auditor's explicitly recorded literal, including the two DISPUTED cells' pre-ruling values (SUT-01 Visual Testing = 2; SUT-04 Security Testing = 2). PROTO-U06 corrected this field's semantics: v1 (schemas/adjudicated-matrix.schema.json) stored the fallback-derived value here instead of null, losing the fact that the source row was blank.

provisional_score.description: The auditor's provisional_score exactly as recorded in audits/<SUT>/audit.md.

confirmation_state.description: protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, Score 3 confirmation, exactly as recorded in audits/<SUT>/audit.md. Null when provisional_score is not 3, or when the step-3 gap is not an evidence-status question (SUT-01 Visual Testing). Independent of, and never inferable from, confirmed_score_as_stored: a cell can have confirmation_state = null with a non-null confirmed_score_as_stored (e.g. SUT-02 Accessibility — Web only, confirmed_score_as_stored = 2), or confirmation_state = CONFIRMED with a null confirmed_score_as_stored (e.g. SUT-02 Web UI Functional).

structural_scope_note.description: Carried through unmodified from audits/<SUT>/audit.md (protocol/study-design-v1.md, section 11 and line 254): a Score 0 cell is never hidden or converted to N/A.

original_adjudicator_outcome.description: The first-run ADJUDICATOR-EU-01 outcome for this cell (schemas/adjudication.schema.json), preserved and never overwritten by a human ruling. UNSUPPORTED is part of the frozen first-run adjudication vocabulary and is representable by this schema version, but no cell in the current E01 data has that outcome and no downstream effective-score precedence rule has been defined for it (protocol/unresolved.md, PROTO-U06); analysis/e01-adjudicated-matrix/generate-matrix.js fails loudly rather than guess if one is ever actually observed.

evidence_ids.description: evidence_id values cited by the first-run adjudication record for this cell (protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md). Never a CSV row or line number.

resolution_source.description: Provenance category for effective_confirmed_score, not a new scientific status: AUDITOR_ADJUDICATION when the auditor's confirmed_score was upheld by ADJUDICATOR-EU-01 (CONFIRMED); HUMAN_RULING when a human ruling on a DISPUTED cell (derived-data/adjudication-rulings/) supplied the effective score.

resolution_source_id.description: The immutable auditor result commit SHA (resolution_source AUDITOR_ADJUDICATION) or ruling_id (resolution_source HUMAN_RULING) that is the source reference for effective_confirmed_score.
